Grade the changed test code in /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c (tests only; the CLI jsonpatch-cli.mjs is context, not under review). Changed in this round:

Spec: .team/notes/jsonpatch-spec.md. All 523 tests pass via `npm test` (2 skip as root by design); 33 near-miss mutants in .team/near-miss/ all fail the suite, including 3 stringifyDeep bugs and 2 EPIPE bugs. Grade correctness, robustness/flakiness (timing, platform), exact assertions, naming, size (files ≤800, functions <50 lines), no console.log. Gate: pass = overall ≥ 9 and no item under 7. End with your GRADE block and a file:line fix list.

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

I ran the file only once because running it in a loop was not permitted, so I have not measured flakiness by repeating runs. I did not re-run the full `npm test` (you report 523 pass) or the near-miss mutants. This passes your gate (overall at least 9, no item under 7), with a few small fixes below.

**What works**
- **Reference serializer** (`/root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/pretty-json.mjs`): it walks the value with an explicit frame stack, which is a different design from the CLI's `stringifyDeep`. So it is less likely to share the CLI's bugs. It is also checked against `JSON.stringify(v, null, 2)` on scalars, -0, escapes, empty containers and `richText(3)` (line 213–216).
- **Mixed object/array test** (`/root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:217–230`): expected values cover escaped keys, U+2028, -0, key order and a member added after the deep part. All are compared exactly through `assertCliOk`.
- **4950-level test** (232–245): it checks its own premise with `assert.throws(..., RangeError)` at line 243, so a Node version where `JSON.stringify` copes with this depth fails loudly instead of quietly not testing the fallback. Doc depth 990 and patch depth 992 both stay under the spec's 1000 limit.
- **EPIPE test** (255–274): the output is about 1.4 MB, far above Linux's 64 KB pipe buffer, so the child really does hit EPIPE. It asserts the exact empty stderr, exit 0, and exactly one chunk read.

**Weaknesses**
- **EPIPE test has no timeout** (256, 266–269): if a CLI change stops the child exiting, the test hangs the whole suite, because node:test has no default timeout. It also depends on output size outrunning the pipe buffer, which nothing checks.
- **Stack-size test checks less than the other deep test** (218): the comment says a 200 KB stack makes `JSON.stringify` fail, but nothing asserts it. If V8's stack use per level drops, this test would still pass through the plain `JSON.stringify` path and stop covering the fallback.
- **Small readability points**:
  - Line 236's path arithmetic is unexplained.
  - The name at 232 hard-codes 4950 while the body computes `levels * 5`.
  - `richInner` (209) returns a JSON pointer, but the name doesn't say so.
  - `innermostOf` sits between two `describe` blocks.
  - `pretty-json.mjs:29` computes `pad` before the pop branch, where it is unused.

## GRADE
Overall: 9/10
Verdict: pass
structure: 9 — clear helpers; the serializer is a separate small module; `innermostOf` sits oddly between describe blocks
naming: 9 — descriptive (`prettyJson`, `richText`, `innermostOf`); `richInner` should say it returns a pointer; test name hard-codes 4950
duplication: 9 — the reference serializer deliberately re-implements the CLI with a different design and is checked against JSON.stringify; no copy-paste
size: 10 — test file 274 lines, helper 42; every function well under 50 lines
errors: 8 — the spawned child's 'error' is passed to reject; but the EPIPE test has no timeout or kill, so a regression hangs the suite
tests: 9 — exact stdout/stderr/exit assertions, the premise check on the 4950 case, mutants reported killed; the stack-size=200 case does not assert its own premise
security: 10 — nothing user-controlled is passed to a shell; temp directory is cleaned up
leftovers: 10 — no console.log, debug code or TODOs
Fixes:
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:256 add `{ timeout: 30000 }` to the test and kill the child on timeout, so a hung CLI fails instead of stalling `npm test`
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:270 also assert that the expected output (`pretty` of the doc) is far larger than 64 KB, so the test can't quietly stop producing EPIPE
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:218 guard the premise as line 243 does: e.g. `spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--stack-size=200', '-e', ...])` and assert that `JSON.stringify` of the 1601-level value throws there
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:236 add a comment that operation k appends a 990-level chain at the current innermost array (depth `levels*(k+1)-1`)
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:232 build the test name from `levels * 5` (or define `levels` outside the test) so the name and the data can't drift apart
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:209 rename `richInner` to `richInnerPointer`
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/cli-output.test.mjs:249 move `innermostOf` up next to `richText`/`richInner` (line 208) so the unit helpers sit together
- /root/bench-runs/h6-8780f14c/test/pretty-json.mjs:29 compute `pad` after the pop branch (it is unused when a frame closes)
